title: Nutrition - Entry Requirements | King's College London

sections.programmeSpecificRequirements: Minimum 2:1 first degree in biological science, including components of biochemistry and physiology, or a registrable qualification in medicine, dentistry or veterinary medicine.
sections.equivalentInternationalQualifications: South Korea: Bachelor degree with a score of 85% or GPA of 3.5/4.5 or 3.3/4.3 or 3.2/4.0 (If both GPA and percentage are present, use percentage over GPA. If only GPA is available, use this instead of asking for percentage).
sections.englishLanguageRequirements: English language band: B To study at King's, it is essential that you can communicate in English effectively in an academic environment.
sections.selectionProcess: Applications must be made online using King's Apply, the Admissions Portal. A non-refundable application fee of £85 applies. Your application will be assessed primarily on the basis of your academic credentials.
sections.applicationClosingDateGuidance: The final application deadlines for this programme are: Overseas (international) fee status: 25 July 2026 (23:59 UK time) Home fee status: 25 August 2026 (23:59 UK time)

supportingInformationRows.label: Personal Statement
supportingInformationRows.details: A personal statement is required. This can be entered directly into the online application form (maximum 4,000 characters) or uploaded as an attachment to the online application form (maximum 2 pages).

supportingInformationRows.label: Previous Academic Study
supportingInformationRows.details: A copy of official academic transcripts is required.

supportingInformationRows.label: References
supportingInformationRows.details: Two references are required with at least one academic. Professional references will be accepted if you have completed your qualifications over five years ago.

supportingInformationRows.label: Other
supportingInformationRows.details: You may also wish to include a CV (Resume) or evidence of professional registration as part of your application.
